name: wormhole-workspace-tools
description: Top 10 tools shipped with WormHole v0.1.0. Each tool is short, single-purpose, readable. The agent picks them up via the skill loader. New tools land here over time.

scripts.test: for f in tools/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done

comment: Most of the ten shipped tools use Node 20 built-ins (fetch, fs/promises, child_process). node-fetch is here for tools that target older Node versions or environments without global fetch. yt-transcript.js shells out to yt-dlp, which the user installs separately.
